senses.gloss: m. (b. h.) ricinus-tree, or the shrub bearing the castor-berry (Greek κίκι, v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Cici, a. Löw, Pfl., p. 353 sq.).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 2:1">ib. II, 1</cite>) <he>ר״ל אמר ק׳ דיונה</he> Resh Laḳish says, it means oil from Jonah’s Ḳiḳayon.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 2:1">Ib.</cite> <he>לדידי … ק׳ דיונה וכ׳</he> I was shown Jonah’s Ḳ., it resembled &c., v. <cite ref="R00495"><he>צְלוּלִיבָא</he></cite>
